# Traceability Matrix

<!-- Generated by tools/trace/trace.py from docs/requirements/HLR.md and LLR.md. Do not edit by hand: edit the requirements and run the script. -->

This matrix links each [high-level requirement](requirements/HLR.md) to the
[low-level requirements](requirements/LLR.md) that refine it, and each LLR to
the code that implements it and the tests that verify it. It is generated from
the requirements tables, and every code file and test named there is resolved
against the repository, so the matrix cannot refer to a file or test that does
not exist. CI runs `python tools/trace/trace.py --check` to keep it current.

## Summary

|------|------:|
| High-level requirements | 20 |
| HLRs refined by at least one LLR | 19 |
| Low-level requirements | 92 |

| LLRs verified by at least one named test | 82 |

| Test cases traced to an LLR | 185 |

### Start-up and platform

- Other: Inspection

<a id="llr-002"></a>**LLR-002** (derived): Reset_Handler shall copy `.data` from flash to RAM and zero `.bss` before calling `main()`.

- Code: [`startup_stm32f4.c`](../firmware/common/src/startup_stm32f4.c)
- Other: All Robot tests (every test boots the firmware)

<a id="llr-003"></a>**LLR-003** (HLR-017): The `.noinit` section shall not be initialised by start-up code or by ELF loaders, and shall be placed at the start of RAM.

- Robot: [Should Record A Divide By Zero Fault Across Reset](../tests/robot/node_a_boot.robot#L64)

<a id="llr-005"></a>**LLR-005** (derived): The link shall fail if less than 4 KiB of RAM remains for the main stack.

- Code: [`stm32f407vg.ld`](../firmware/common/linker/stm32f407vg.ld)
- Other: Build (enforced at link time)

<a id="llr-010"></a>**LLR-010** (HLR-016): Each node shall start the IWDG with a nominal timeout of 500 ms before entering its main loop.

- Code: [`iwdg.c`](../firmware/common/src/iwdg.c), [`main.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/main.c), [`main.c`](../firmware/node_b/src/main.c)

<a id="llr-011"></a>**LLR-011** (HLR-016): Node B's main loop shall reload the IWDG on every iteration; Node A's reload is supervised (LLR-113). If the loop or a task stalls, the node shall be reset within 500 ms (nominal).

<a id="llr-012"></a>**LLR-012** (HLR-017): The reset record shall be protected by a magic number and a CRC-32. On a mismatch it shall be reinitialised and the reset treated as power-on.

<a id="llr-013"></a>**LLR-013** (HLR-017): The reset counter shall increment on every warm reset and be reported in the boot log.

<a id="llr-045"></a>**LLR-045** (HLR-010): A failed IMU read shall mark the sample invalid until the next successful read, and an invalid sample shall not be returned to its users.

### Flight data recorder (Node A)

<a id="llr-050"></a>**LLR-050** (derived): The flight-data flash shall be an MT25Q on SPI1 (PA5/PA6/PA7, mode 0, 8 MHz) with a software chip select on PA4. Every SPI status wait shall be bounded.

- Code: [`board.c`](../firmware/common/src/board.c), [`spi.c`](../firmware/common/src/spi.c), [`mt25q.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/mt25q.c)

<a id="llr-051"></a>**LLR-051** (HLR-018): At start-up Node A shall check the flash JEDEC ID (Micron, 8 to 16 MiB). If the check fails, it shall log the cause and keep running without the recorder.

- Code: [`mt25q.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/mt25q.c), [`flashlog.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/flashlog.c)
- Robot: [Should Find An Empty Flash On First Boot](../tests/robot/node_a_flashlog.robot#L48), [Should Keep Running Without A Flash](../tests/robot/node_a_flashlog.robot#L96)

<a id="llr-052"></a>**LLR-052** (HLR-018): The log shall be an append-only array of 64-byte records, each holding a magic number, type, payload length, a sequence number equal to its slot index, a timestamp and a CRC-32.

- Code: [`flashlog.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/flashlog.c)

<a id="llr-053"></a>**LLR-053** (HLR-018): At start-up the end of the log shall be found by a binary search for the first erased slot, and new records shall be appended after the existing ones.

- Code: [`flashlog.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/flashlog.c)
- Robot: [Should Keep The Log Across A Reset](../tests/robot/node_a_flashlog.robot#L77)

<a id="llr-054"></a>**LLR-054** (HLR-018): Node A shall record a boot record (reset cause and count) at start-up and the latest valid IMU sample every 100 ms (10 Hz).

- Code: [`main.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/main.c), [`main.c`](../firmware/node_b/src/main.c), [`tasks.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/tasks.c)
- Robot: [Should Record At 10 Hz Without Losses](../tests/robot/node_a_flashlog.robot#L52), [Should Record The Boot And The Imu Data](../tests/robot/node_a_flashlog.robot#L58)

<a id="llr-055"></a>**LLR-055** (HLR-007, HLR-018): Flash program and erase operations shall not be waited for by the tasks that queue records. Records shall be queued in RAM (8 records) under a mutex and written by LogTask through a polled state machine.

- Robot: [Should Sample The Imu At 100 Hz](../tests/robot/node_a_imu.robot#L58)
- Other: Inspection

<a id="llr-056"></a>**LLR-056** (HLR-018): Each 4 KiB subsector shall be erased just before its first record is written.

### Real-time operating system (Node A)

<a id="llr-110"></a>**LLR-110** (HLR-007, HLR-009, HLR-011): Node A shall run FreeRTOS with six tasks in rate-monotonic priority order: CanTxTask (6, 2 ms), ImuTask (5, 10 ms), ControlTask (4, 20 ms), LoadTask (3, demonstration only), AiTask (2, 320 ms, woken by ImuTask) and LogTask (1, 10 ms), each periodic task on a fixed period.

- Code: [`tasks.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/tasks.c)
- Robot: [Should Run The Tasks Under FreeRTOS](../tests/robot/node_a_rtos.robot#L43)

<a id="llr-111"></a>**LLR-111** (derived): All kernel objects (tasks, stacks, mutexes) shall be statically allocated; dynamic allocation shall be disabled.

- Code: [`FreeRTOSConfig.h`](../firmware/node_a/src/rtos/FreeRTOSConfig.h), [`tasks.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/tasks.c), [`lock.h`](../firmware/node_a/src/rtos/lock.h)
- Other: Build (enforced at link time)

<a id="llr-112"></a>**LLR-112** (HLR-016): Interrupt handlers shall not call the kernel, and shall run above `configMAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY` so the kernel never masks them.

- Code: [`board.c`](../firmware/common/src/board.c), [`FreeRTOSConfig.h`](../firmware/node_a/src/rtos/FreeRTOSConfig.h)
- Other: Inspection

<a id="llr-113"></a>**LLR-113** (HLR-016): LogTask shall reload the IWDG only if CanTxTask, ImuTask and ControlTask have each completed a cycle since the previous reload, checked every 100 ms.

- Code: [`tasks.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/tasks.c)
- Robot: [Should Recover From A Stalled Task Through The Watchdog](../tests/robot/node_a_rtos.robot#L72)

<a id="llr-114"></a>**LLR-114** (HLR-016): Data shared between tasks (IMU sample, GPS fix, navigation state, safety state, recorder queue, log output) shall be accessed under mutexes with priority inheritance.

- Code: [`imu.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/imu.c), [`gps.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/gps.c), [`nav.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/nav.c), [`safety.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/safety.c), [`flashlog.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/flashlog.c), [`log.c`](../firmware/common/src/log.c)
- Robot: [Should Bound The Wait With Priority Inheritance](../tests/robot/node_a_rtos.robot#L64)

<a id="llr-115"></a>**LLR-115** (HLR-016, HLR-017): A stack overflow or a failed kernel assertion shall be logged and shall reset the node. Each task shall keep at least 100 words of its stack unused.

- Code: [`rtos_port.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/rtos/rtos_port.c)
- Robot: [Should Report Task Stack Margins](../tests/robot/node_a_rtos.robot#L51)

<a id="llr-116"></a>**LLR-116** (derived): Node A shall provide a debug-console demonstration of priority inversion: the recorder lock as a binary semaphore (`i`) and as a mutex (`m`), reporting ControlTask's longest wait and missed deadlines.

- Code: [`tasks.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/tasks.c), [`flashlog.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/flashlog.c)
- Robot: [Should Show Priority Inversion With A Plain Semaphore](../tests/robot/node_a_rtos.robot#L56), [Should Bound The Wait With Priority Inheritance](../tests/robot/node_a_rtos.robot#L64)

### Vibration monitor (Node A)

<a id="llr-140"></a>**LLR-140** (HLR-009): Node A shall keep a sliding window of the last 64 valid IMU samples (accelerometer in g, gyroscope in deg/s) and hand a copy to AiTask every 32 samples once the window is full. A failed IMU read shall restart the window.

- Code: [`vib_features.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/vib_features.c), [`health.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/health.c), [`tasks.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/tasks.c)

<a id="llr-141"></a>**LLR-141** (HLR-009): For each axis, Node A shall remove the window mean, apply a periodic Hann window, compute the DFT power of bins 1 to 32 and output log10 of the power summed over the bands 1-2, 3-5, 6-9, 10-14, 15-20, 21-26 and 27-32 plus 1e-6, agreeing with the Python reference (ml/features.py) within 0.002.

- Code: [`vib_features.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/vib_features.c)
- Unit: [features_match_the_python_reference](../tests/unit/test_vib_features.c#L37), [a_constant_signal_gives_the_floor](../tests/unit/test_vib_features.c#L95)

<a id="llr-142"></a>**LLR-142** (HLR-009): Node A shall classify each window with the INT8 model in `vib_model_data.c` on TensorFlow Lite Micro, using only statically allocated memory (a 2 KB tensor arena), after checking the model's schema version and its input and output shapes and types at start-up; a model that fails these checks shall disable the monitor and be logged.

- Code: [`vib_model.cc`](../firmware/node_a/src/vib_model.cc), [`health.c`](../firmware/node_a/src/health.c)
- Robot: [Should Load The Model At Start-Up](../tests/robot/node_a_ai.robot#L44)

<a id="llr-143"></a>**LLR-143** (HLR-009): Node A shall raise the vibration alarm with the most frequent fault class when 3 of the last 4 windows are classified as a fault, and clear it after 8 consecutive nominal windows.

<a id="llr-144"></a>**LLR-144** (HLR-009, HLR-018): Node A shall log every change of the vibration alarm and record it in the flight-data recorder.
